description: This file contains unit tests for the Data Asset Management system, specifically testing the database-backed asset lifecycle operations such as creation, updating, and deletion, utilizing the Xunit framework.

classes.name: DbBackedAssetLifecycleTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of asset lifecycle operations in a database-backed system, including create, update, duplicate check, and delete functionality.

methods.name: Create_asset_persists_and_returns_201_with_id
methods.description: Tests that creating an asset persists data correctly and returns the appropriate response with asset ID.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_duplicate_permit_eu_id_with_409
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to create an asset with a duplicate permit EU ID results in a conflict response.

methods.name: Update_asset_persists_changed_fields
methods.description: Checks that updating an asset persists the modified fields correctly in the system.

methods.name: Delete_asset_soft_deletes_and_subsequent_get_is_404
methods.description: Ensures that deleting an asset performs a soft delete, and subsequent attempts to retrieve the asset result in a not found response.
